run_training_experiment: run a transformer encoder-decoder training experiment on math environments with configurable epochs and batch size
run_evaluation_only: run evaluation only on a pretrained model using beam search decoding and log scores
run_multi_gpu_training: run distributed multi-GPU or multi-node training with SLURM support and gradient accumulation
export_environment_data: export training data for specified tasks without running the training loop
configure_model_parameters: configure transformer model parameters including embedding dimension, encoder-decoder layers, heads, and dropout
